players.product: multimodal clinical data, diagnostics, and AI applications

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 earnings release: gross profit rose 26% year-over-year to $246.5 million, led by growth in Data and Applications. GAAP gross margin was 64.4% versus 62.0% in Q2 2025; Diagnostics gross margin was 62.6% versus 58.8%, and Data and applications gross margin was 70.2% versus 72.7%.
quarterly_data.figure: gross profit $246.5 million (+26%); gross margin 64.4% vs 62.0%; Diagnostics 62.6% vs 58.8%; Data and applications 70.2% vs 72.7%

quarterly_data.signal: Personalis: the definitive agreement to acquire Personalis tightly integrates Personalis' ultrasensitive NeXT Personal MRD technology into Tempus' diagnostic platform; the transaction is expected to close in late Q4 2026 or early 2027 and Tempus's 2026 guidance assumes no impact from it. CEO Eric Lefkofsky: 'Through our existing collaboration with Personalis, we have already demonstrated the strength of combining highly sensitive MRD technology with our commercial infrastructure.'
quarterly_data.figure: expected close in late Q4 2026 or early 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Recent operational highlights in the Q2 2026 release: a strategic collaboration with the Keck School of Medicine of USC to integrate Tempus' AI platform, molecular diagnostics and clinical trial matching across more than 1.5 million annual patient visits; the introduction of Tempus Preview, providing preliminary results for high impact biomarkers within ~24 hours of tissue receipt; and the launch, with Yale New Haven Hospital and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, of the digital pathology IMS Open-Source Consortium.
quarterly_data.figure: Keck School of Medicine of USC collaboration across more than 1.5 million annual patient visits; Tempus Preview results within ~24 hours
